name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either Mikhail goes with Fork or someone in the Morning Study Group goes with Pirc.
Either Boris goes with Sicilian or Fork does not go with Slav (but not both) if and only if Italian does not go with Gambit.
Judit, Magnus, and Vera go with Italian, Discovery, and Skewer, in some order.
Exactly two of Magnus, the player who loves the Gambit, and the player who loves the Zugzwang belong to the King's-Pawn Camp.
Mikhail, Vera, and Sicilian go with Fork, Gambit, and Zugzwang, in some order.
Exactly one member of the Morning Study Group goes with (Caro-Kann or Slav).
Exactly two members of the King's-Pawn Camp go with (Zugzwang or Discovery).
